rule: An extra title is accepted only when its mid is one of that ecosystem's mids. A different mid is rejected and is not added to the query. Wave 2 starts with the English Wikipedia title and the normal-rank Wikidata P646 mid. No extra alias is accepted before the scan.
neighbor_rule: A neighbor or competitor title is added only when that item has an English Wikipedia title and a non-deprecated P646 mid. The mid is the item's own mid. A title with no such mid is rejected and is not put in the query. A brand's own extra alias is still accepted only when its mid is one of that brand's mids.
